jobs.title: Finance Officer
jobs.description: We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and proactive Finance Officer to oversee the company's day-to-day financial operations, with a primary focus on Accounts Payable (AP), budget management, and cash flow monitoring. The ideal candidate should have strong financial management skills, a keen eye for accuracy, and the ability to ensure that company funds are properly monitored, allocated, and utilized. Key Responsibilities: 1. Accounts Payable Management Manage the company's accounts payable transactions, ensuring timely and accurate processing of supplier invoices and payments. Review and verify invoices, purchase orders, billing statements, and supporting documents. Monitor payment schedules and ensure obligations are settled within agreed payment terms. Maintain accurate records of outstanding payables and supplier accounts. Coordinate with suppliers and internal departments regarding payment concerns and discrepancies. 2. Budget Management and Monitoring Assist in the preparation, consolidation, and monitoring of departmental and company budgets. Track actual expenses against approved budgets and identify variances. Monitor spending and ensure expenses are within approved allocations. Prepare budget utilization reports and provide recommendations for cost control and expense management. Coordinate with department heads regarding budget requests and expense forecasts. 3. Cash Flow Management Monitor daily cash positions, cash availability, and projected cash requirements. Prepare cash flow forecasts to ensure sufficient funds are available for operational needs and scheduled payments. Monitor incoming and outgoing cash transactions. Identify potential cash flow gaps and recommend appropriate actions. Prepare regular cash flow reports to support management's financial planning and decision-making. 4. jobs.title: Category Analyst
jobs.description: The Category Analyst is crucial in supporting the planning and execution of sales targets, analyzing sales data, coordinating demand planning for new collections, managing inventory effectively, and conducting competitor checks. They work closely with departments such as Sales, Creative, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Production, Quality Control, and Distribution to ensure alignment and optimize performance. What you'll do: Target Setting: Assist in setting monthly sales targets based on historical sales trends per month per class category and store performance. Sales Data Analysis: Monitor sell-through of all collections launched within the past six months. Generate monthly sales reports for assigned categories. Demand Planning and Execution for New Collections: Collaborate in proposing collection budgets based on historical sales trends. Assist in planning upcoming collection demand by analyzing class type, sub-class types, sizes, fabric, color, and design/styles. Support in proposing store budgets aligned with the total demand planned for upcoming collections. Assist in allocating inventory to stores and online platforms based on targets. Coordinate with Production and Quality Control departments to ensure the availability of new collections before the launch date. Coordinate with the Distribution Department to align delivery schedules based on allocation. Generate reports comparing transfer orders versus out slips for new collections. Inventory Management: Analyze monthly inventory and three-month average sales to identify Months to Sell (MTS). Facilitate the repeat of available stocks from the warehouse and pull-out from other stores based on demand. Identify and consolidate low and broken on-hand quantities per style in all stores to the store with the highest sales demand. Support markdown strategies based on a markdown calendar and propose markdowns based on remaining on-hand quantities and sell-through rates. Competitors Check: Conduct regular competitor

jobs.title: BTL & Activation Specialist
jobs.description: The BTL & Activation Specialist supports the sourcing, costing, and execution of BTL activations, events, and other on-ground marketing activities. The role focuses on identifying, evaluating, and managing reliable suppliers, production partners, venues, manpower providers, fabricators, and other service providers needed for successful campaign execution. The position works closely with Account Management, Creative, Finance, and Operations to translate campaign requirements into practical and cost-effective solutions. Summary Supplier & Partner Management Source, evaluate, and manage reliable suppliers and production partners for BTL and on-ground activations. Build and maintain a supplier database and strong vendor relationships. Assess supplier capabilities, pricing, quality, reliability, and capacity. Monitor supplier performance and negotiate competitive rates, payment terms, and other commercial conditions. BTL & Activation Sourcing & Costing Source suppliers, venues, manpower, and production solutions based on campaign requirements and client briefs. Support sourcing for brand activations, roadshows, mall/retail activations, trade events, sampling, product launches, exhibitions/booths, pop-ups, experiential marketing, POSM, logistics, and production. Scout and recommend suitable suppliers, venues, fabricators, and manpower providers. Request, compare, and analyze supplier quotations and prepare cost estimates. Support proposal and budget development with Account Management and Operations. Identify cost-saving opportunities while maintaining quality and campaign requirements. Provide cost comparisons, recommendations, and identify potential risks or hidden costs. Help monitor project costs against approved budgets. Activation & Production Execution Coordinate with suppliers and internal teams from pre-production to project completion. Ensure suppliers understand project requirements, timelines, quality standards, and deliverables. Coordinate production schedule
